description.value: The Rotary Centre for the Arts is Kelowna's primary arts and culture hub, operating multiple gallery spaces, performance venues, and artist studios in the downtown core. It presents a year-round slate of live performances, art education programs, and community events, and has earned Silver at the Best of Kelowna Awards every year since 2014. The on-site Roma Nord Bistro adds a dining option for visitors catching a show or exploring the centre's exhibitions.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 38m; rack at 42m; lockers (secure) at 78m; lockers (secure) at 78m; rack at 88m.

Roma Nord Bistro is explicitly listed as an on-site venue in the website's Venue section, confirming food service on site. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, bike rack, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content, so all remain null per evidence rules.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Rotary Centre for the Arts is a well-established, award-winning public arts venue in downtown Kelowna with an on-site bistro, making it a worthwhile cultural stop for touring cyclists passing through the city.
